provenance.source: JPL Saturn-system orbital data; the shape uses the controlled Cassini September 2005 frame. Its displayed orientation is arbitrary because Hyperion rotates chaotically.
provenance.qualification: Computed Hyperion Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. The ephemeris locates the Sun, but Hyperion’s body attitude is an explicitly arbitrary display orientation. Its directional lighting is a display convention, not a prediction of the current tumbling surface phase.
